Introduction

Kim Suyoung is a South Korean singer who has been independent since April 2024, previously under Friends.net and later with Magic Strawberry Sound. She debuted on June 28, 2017, with the mini album "Behind".

In 2021, she participated in the composition/arrangement/chorus of IU 's 5th regular album's last track, "Epilogue".
